title: Reborn to Build My Own Empire
description: Reborn to Build My Own Empire is a 73-episode series from DramaBox.

title: Fly Back To My Heart, Captain
description: Air traffic controller Nora has secretly loved Captain Casper for six years, spending three as his secret lover. Ready to leave, she discovers she’s pregnant, right as his first love returns. Stand-in or true love? One blind landing will force the captain to confess his heart.

title: Tempest：The Last Mecha
description: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. But when Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt must unleash his hidden identity. Unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync, he commands The Tempest to crush his enemies and save the world from an extinction-level alien swarm!

title: Mafia Single Daddy’s Stolen Bride
description: On her wedding day, Lucia catches her fiancé cheating—only to be sold to ruthless mafia boss Nico Romano to pay off a gambling debt. Forced into a one-year contract marriage with Nico, she becomes nanny to his traumatized young niece and gradually uncovers the caring man hidden beneath his cold, dangerous facade. But as enemies close in and their forbidden attraction deepens, Lucia must decide whether trusting a mafia boss is worth risking her heart—and her life.

title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates
description: Orphaned Caine spent ten years protecting his foster father Alpha's five daughters, believing they were his destined mates. However, the arrival of Seth, a manipulative rogue wolf, shatters his world. Blinded by Seth's deceit, the five sisters turn against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and stripping away his honor and sacred armor to appease the rogue. Pushed to the brink of despair by the family he once loved, Caine faces a turning point at his Ascension Ceremony. Will the powerful warrior continue to endure their cruel betrayal, or will he sever their fated bonds to claim a greater destiny?

title: The Heirless Mafia Boss Claimed Me
description: Poor college student Lily is drugged and sent to Victor Rossi, the ruthless mafia boss believed to be infertile, by her boyfriend and best friend. Two months later, she discovers she's pregnant with Victor's child. When her boyfriend tries to kill the baby and sell her off, Victor arrives—and for the first time in ten years, he has something worth protecting.
